notes.title: DLC Update : Regular Season
notes.content:
Hello Everyday Golfers,
Are you having fun with the pre-season?

I’m happy to announce that the regular season begins with new DLC!

[list]
[*][b]DLC[/b]
2 DLCs are released! [list]
[*]Green Reading Package
Becomes able to confirm expected putting trajectory on the green.
[*]Golden Wedge Set
Preservation rate of the lie's driving distance is accurately displayed. [/list]
[*][b]Accessories[/b]
With purchasing a DLC, you can receive items below.[list]
[*]Mask
[*]Ball’s trajectory [/list]
[/list]
One DLC bundle is cheaper than two DLCs.
If you have not purchased Everyday Golf VR yet, do not miss the special sale for 14 days!

Details of the pre-season updates can be found on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791458609215/announcements/detail/1662271429589577007]here[/url].

notes.title: PvP Update : Pre-Season
notes.content:
[h1] [New Features] [/h1]
[list]
[*] Online Match Mode ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791458609215/announcements/detail/1660018815116870345]Dev Note : Online Match Details & Rank[/url])
[list]
[*] Quick Match
Players can enter at the start of each hole, and a maximum of 4 players can be played together at a hole.
[*] Custom Match
Set your favorite options and invite your friends to the game! A maximum of 4 players can be played together.
[/list]
[*] Indoor Practice Court
Practice with your wedges and a putter in this place. Warm up in here while waiting for the Online Match.
If you put a ball into a hole-in machine in the wall, you’ll get some bonus.
[*] Rank
Ranked by players’ winning points that gained in Online Match Mode. Earn many winning points and challenge the highest rank!
[*] New Items Released
[list]
[*] Accessories ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791458609215/announcements/detail/3199123443078909981]Dev Note : Accessories[/url])
New accessories are sold in the shop in lobby.
[*] Boosters
Boosters will help you to get more winning points in Online Match. Play harder before the time goes by!
Note: Boosters cannot be replaced to other boosters. Use carefully.
[/list]
[*] Friends
Search for your friend’s nickname, or send a friend request to your favorite player in Online Match! If the player accepts the request, you can become friends.
[*] In-game Features
[list]
[*] Free Moving in the Field
Freely move around in the field! But not in your turn, only in other player’s turn.
[*] Voice Chat
Chat with other players while playing the Online Match.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1] [Changes] [/h1]
[list]
[*] Lobby
Miniature size type lobby changes into the real size type lobby.
[*] Tour Mode
Time to reset is checked on the server.
[*] Ball’s Spin
The left and right spin values of the ball are applied.
[*] Driving Distance Rate by Lies
[list]
[*] Driving distance rate is shown as a range value.
[*] The rate varies within range values for each play.
[/list]
[*] Club Function
Golf clubs that are sold in the shop has slightly lower function then before.
[*] Control
[list]
[*] Vive Controller
[list]
[*] The click range of the touchpad has been slightly adjusted.
[*] The newly added function has been applied.
[/list]
[*] Oculus Touch Controller
The newly added function has been applied.
[/list]
[*] Event
Now you cannot get free Dirway balls even if you complete the tour mode at first.
[*] ETC
Some minor bugs have also been fixed.
[/list]

※ Today’s update is the pre-season version, so you cannot use DLC yet.
※ Unlike the previous announcement, the pre-season play is available on Steam and the other platform. Also, even if the pre-season ends, winning points will not be initialized, so feel free to play!

notes.title: Club Grip Guide and Second Patch Schedule
notes.content:
I’ll let you know how to change the club grip in the next patch.

[h1]Holding[/h1]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/4804d05fa4fc668154ca0e2c3e403473c1cc8238.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/511113be1bb9638c01437eca277a8d7db455843e.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/6447ccb58cb3cb4411ff830f5078a8760a94cdca.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/3f9f92d4ad9e0445c7b39e6ba206a6920f056abc.jpg[/img][/url]
Same as before. The club becomes visible only when you are holding the trigger.

[h1]Toggle[/h1]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/b43a5b7b67b663ad493044be06150c1803e2cef5.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/9d1284f1edd4e8d5e6a3f89729a2d744f9c4f9ee.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/823b1d5b9b9206947bc9ab861574fd2c6cb818ea.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29087807/a7954dafe8ea1ceb22f4cb7204fb1a1eba92328d.jpg[/img][/url]
This is the new type of club grip. Pressing the trigger makes the club visible or invisible.
While you’re holding the club, you cannot go on to the Replay Screen or Swing Analysis. Also if you want to see your controller’s lay and press the UI button, you should release the club.


You can see the other details of the second patch in here.
http://steamcommunity.com/games/643590/announcements/detail/1440442886464970876

This will be updated on August 25, 2017, at 12:00 am PDT. However, the specific time could be changed due to internal and external circumstances.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE #2 : Oculus Left-hand and a Toggle Trigger
notes.content:
Hello Everyday Golfers,
The 2nd update date that many of you inquired is set!
It is August 24, 2017 at 12:00 am PDT. If you are connecting at that time, you will need to turn the Steam off and on again to download the updated version.
 
Here are several features that have been added and fixed in this update.
 

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Left-handed Option for Oculus Users
  The left-handed option will be available even though you’re not a Vive user! Check ‘ETC’ in Option after the update.
[*]Club Grip Option Added
  You can choose whether you’re holding a trigger or toggle a trigger in club grip on Club option.
 [/list]
 
 
[h1]CHANGES & FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*]Slowing Down Error
  We fixed an issue that sometimes the screen goes slow down drastically when you are swing after the first update.
[*]Graphic Error
 We fixed an issue that a graphic error in the course.
[*]Displaying Error of Yard Distance Unit
 Yard distance unit shown incorrectly in the play is fixed.
[/list]
 
 
* The specific time could be changed due to internal and external circumstances.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE #1 : Items and the Another Putter Practice Mode
notes.content:
Hello Everyday Golfers,
We’re happy to announce the first update you’ve been waiting for!

Our dev team has prepared gifts for those who enjoy Everyday Golf VR. After the update, clear one of the Tour Mode. Then you’ll receive 50 Dirway balls in Everyday Golf VR!

The first update will take place at 11:00 pm PDT July 31st. If you are connecting at that time, you will need to turn the Steam off and on again to download the updated version.
(The specific time could be changed due to internal and external circumstances.)

Here are several features that have been added and fixed in this update. I hope you’ll like it!



[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]SHOP
  Buy new clubs and balls that have special features.
[olist]
  [*]GEAR CLUB SET
    These clubs reduce slice or hook.
    Once you open REGULAR course, you can purchase them.
  [*]MUSCLE CLUB SET
    These clubs make the ball fly farther.
    Once you open WORLD-II course, you can purchase them.
  [*]GOLF BALLS
    Each ball has a different kind of features.
    After the update, you can purchase them.
    Each time the ball falls into hazard or OB, you’ll lose one ball. However, you don’t have to worry. Wisecat balls are always with you!
[/olist]
[*]BAG
  Check your equipment or change to new clubs or balls.
[*]New Practice Mode: PUTTER - EASY
  Practice long putts and short putts on the flat green.
[/list]


[h1]CHANGES & FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*]Practice Mode: PUTTER ⇒ Practice Mode: PUTTER - DIFFICULT
  Existing Putter Practice Mode that has curved green has changed to difficult Putter Practice Mode.
[*]In-game UI
  The brand name and the feature of the selected club will appear on In-game UI.
  You can check the ball information in the center more clearly.
[*]Power reduction rate on the bunker changed: 60% → 40%
  Fixed an issue that the ball moved too short in the bunker.
[*]Long putting
  Fixed an issue that the ball moved too far in a long putt.
[*]Green topography view beside the green
  Fixed an issue that the screen switched to green topography view in the steep incline near the green.
[*]Green grid in yard
  The grid on the green will be displayed differently on distance units.
[/list]


TIP. Beware to not spend all the money in the shop! It can make hard to earn the course open fee.
